requirements.statement: A User signs in with single sign-on to access the converter

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before reaching the converter
A successfully signed-in User reaches the converter screen

requirements.statement: A User chooses a source currency and a target currency from a list of supported currencies

criteria.must: The converter presents a list of supported currencies to choose as the source
The converter presents a list of supported currencies to choose as the target

requirements.statement: A User enters an amount in the source currency and sees its equivalent value in the target currency

criteria.must: The User can enter a numeric amount in the source currency
Submitting a valid amount displays the converted value in the target currency
An invalid or non-numeric amount is rejected with a clear message

requirements.statement: A User sees the current exchange rate used for the conversion

criteria.must: The conversion result displays the exchange rate applied

requirements.statement: The product offers a curated shortlist of major currencies rather than every currency a provider publishes

criteria.must: The currency picker's options are limited to a curated shortlist of major currencies
